title: Global compiler warning suppression in Directory.Build.props
observed: Directory.Build.props suppresses 9 warning codes globally (SYSLIB1050;SYSLIB1043;CS0649;CS0169;CS0414;CS8632;CS8981;CS8500;CS9191) and all 7 csproj files set <Nullable>annotations</Nullable> and <AllowUnsafeBlocks>True</AllowUnsafeBlocks>.
expected: Compiler warnings (unassigned fields CS0649, unused fields CS0169/CS0414, unsafe pointers CS8500, refness mismatch CS9191) should not be globally masked across all projects.

title: Zero NuGet PackageReferences; all 3rd-party dependencies bound via local HintPath DLLs
observed: PackageReference count = 0; raw <HintPath> binary reference count = 49 across 7 .csproj files (dotnet list package --vulnerable cannot audit any 3rd-party dependencies).
expected: Third-party libraries (Sentry, Velopack, ClearScript, Vortice, WebView2, WinAppSDK) should be managed via pinned NuGet PackageReferences so vulnerability scanners can audit them.

title: build-dist.ps1 ships Debug assemblies + PDBs and omits HeyClicky.exe apphost
observed: build-dist.ps1:34 compiles '-c Debug', copies .pdb debug symbols into dist/kursor-desktop/, and omits HeyClicky.exe from  (bin HeyClicky.exe SHA256=32C071E81A0677191F9160A5BC116E5E0B49BA60FFBF817A4EC659088679034D vs dist HeyClicky.exe SHA256=26AB779203881266FB8FC0BD4664D26D7167C0C185C3B63638C79EA7EEE3F4F9).
expected: Distribution script should build Release configuration, exclude debug PDBs unless requested, and keep apphost executable synchronized.

title: build-dist.ps1 and overlay-and-launch.ps1 reference non-existent Kursor.Drawing3D/Assets/Engine
observed: Directory src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing3D/Assets/Engine does not exist; all 5 V8 JS files reside in src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing/Assets/Engine.
expected: Asset directory layout and staging scripts should agree on where 3D engine JS assets live.

title: Vulnerable @hono/node-server (<2.1.3, GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f) & Node engine version mismatch
observed: @hono/node-server is '^1.14.0' (installed 1.19.19, vulnerable to GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f). package.json engines requires 'node >=24.0.0', whereas setup-kursor.ps1:29 and README.md:127 say 'Node.js v22+' and setup-kursor.ps1 does not check major version.
expected: @hono/node-server upgraded to >=2.1.3 and consistent Node.js engine version checks across package.json, setup-kursor.ps1, and README.md.

title: Hardcoded developer path C:\Users\ubaid\... in src/backend/src/routes/worker.ts
observed: LOCAL_APP_CONFIG_PATH hardcodes 'C:\\Users\\ubaid\\AppData\\Local\\HeyClicky\\app-config.json' at worker.ts:7-8.
expected: Resolve %LOCALAPPDATA% dynamically via process.env.LOCALAPPDATA or os.homedir().

title: start-kursor.ps1 -Restart ignores backend/sidecars and fails silently if port 8787 is occupied by another service
observed: start-kursor.ps1 -Restart only kills 'HeyClicky', leaving backend node.exe on :8787 and sidecars running; if a non-Kursor service occupies :8787, Test-BackendRunning returns false and spawns a conflicting node process without verifying health after 3s sleep.
expected: -Restart should stop both desktop/sidecar processes and the port 8787 backend, and verify /health after spawning.

title: Duplicate/conflicting Windows autostart registrations across install-autostart.ps1 and LaunchAtLogin.cs
observed: install-autostart.ps1 registers BOTH HKCU\...\Run\Kursor AND Startup\Kursor.lnk (launching start-kursor-hidden.vbs twice simultaneously at login), while in-app LaunchAtLogin.cs:12 writes HKCU\...\Run\HeyClicky (launching HeyClicky.exe without backend). uninstall-autostart.ps1 leaves Run\HeyClicky and Desktop\Kursor.lnk behind.
expected: Use a single canonical autostart mechanism and registry value name shared between scripts and LaunchAtLogin.cs.

title: %LOCALAPPDATA%\HeyClicky vs %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kursor split between AppPaths.cs and setup scripts
observed: seed-local-auth.ps1 and setup-kursor.ps1 seed both %LOCALAPPDATA%\HeyClicky and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kursor, but AppPaths.cs:12 defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\HeyClicky and start-kursor.ps1 never sets KURSOR_DATA_DIR.
expected: Desktop AppPaths.cs and setup/launcher scripts should use a single unified data directory.

title: Missing LICENSE / THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and unanchored Release/Debug rules in .gitignore
observed: No LICENSE or THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES file exists in repo root; 4,260 tracked files include 2,096 decompiled files in reference/decompiled/; .gitignore:38 has unanchored [Rr]elease/ and [Dd]ebug/ patterns.
expected: Repository should include explicit licensing/attribution documentation and properly scoped .gitignore rules.

title: All 7 desktop .csproj files compile HeyClicky*.dll/exe with HeyClicky AssemblyInfo metadata
observed: All 7 .csproj files specify <AssemblyName>HeyClicky*</AssemblyName>; AssemblyInfo.cs sets AssemblyCompany/Product/Title to 'HeyClicky' and leaks original developer path 'C:\Users\niles\code\clicky-closed\windows\src\HeyClicky.App\'.
expected: Assemblies and PE metadata should be rebranded to Kursor.

title: Production HeyClicky endpoints, Supabase anon JWT, Sentry DSN, PostHog key, and Velopack feed baked into binary
observed: AssemblyInfo.cs bakes in HeyClicky's live PostHog key, Sentry DSN (with SendDefaultPii=true in CrashReporting.cs:233), and GitHub UpdateFeedUrl; AppBundleConfiguration.cs:36-43 switches to api.heyclicky.com + mrpvynsdsnimuisyhkow.supabase.co if use-production-backend.flag exists; ClickyInkImages.cs:60 defaults WorkerBaseUrl to https://api.heyclicky.com.
expected: Remove third-party production telemetry keys, update feeds, and cloud fallback URLs so Kursor cannot phone home to HeyClicky infrastructure.

title: OS-level mutex, named pipe, process killer, URI scheme (heyclicky://), and file association collisions
observed: SingleInstance.cs:80 uses appId='HeyClicky' (mutex Local\HeyClicky-<SID>, pipe HeyClicky-<SID>-args) and kills processes named 'HeyClicky' (line 322); ProtocolRegistration.cs hijacks heyclicky:// and clicky://; FileOpenRegistration.cs registers HeyClicky.Document across 22 extensions.
expected: Use isolated Kursor mutex/pipe names, kursor:// URI protocol, and Kursor.Document ProgId.

title: Incomplete UI & prompt rebranding (4,712 'HeyClicky' and 19,632 'Clicky' occurrences in src/desktop)
observed: App.cs:111, SingleInstance.cs:345, BillingUi.cs:503, SettingsContent.cs:1205,2540 show 'HeyClicky' dialogs and 'hi@heyclicky.com'; TrayIcon.cs:232 registers 'HeyClickyTray'; TrayTooltip.cs:25 says 'N Clickys working'; CodexHomeManager.cs:74-91 instructs agents to tell users 'HeyClicky Settings -> Integrations'.
expected: User-facing dialogs, support contacts, tray classes, and agent system instructions should consistently use Kursor.

title: Direct IP/copyright exposure: 2,096 decompiled C# files tracked in git + Humansongs-signed binaries & proprietary assets
observed: Repo tracks 2,096 ILSpy-decompiled C# files in reference/decompiled/ and 2,097 in src/desktop/, plus executable-file/HeyClicky-Setup.exe and dist/kursor-desktop/ binaries signed by 'CN=Humansongs, Inc' (HeyClicky.exe, HeyClicky-Update.exe, clicky-harness.exe, ClickyBrowserHost.exe) and 171 proprietary audio/video/font/sprite assets (89.4 MB).
expected: Clean-room implementation with original/licensed assets and zero redistribution of third-party proprietary binaries or decompiled source.

title: Env var drift between README.md (ONEBRAIN_MODEL), .env.example (6 unused vars), and backend code (KURSOR_BRAIN_MODEL)
observed: README.md:84 documents ONEBRAIN_MODEL which is never read in src/backend/src/ (brain.ts:598 reads KURSOR_BRAIN_MODEL || OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL); .env.example omits KURSOR_BRAIN_MODEL and lists 6 env vars (KURSOR_DEV_BYPASS_AUTH, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, COMPOSIO_API_KEY, WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER, BRAVE_API_KEY, SERPER_API_KEY) never read in backend code.
expected: README.md, .env.example, and src/backend/src/ should use identical environment variable names and honor documented flags like KURSOR_DEV_BYPASS_AUTH.

title: README.md documents non-existent writeOnPage primitive and claims setup-kursor seeds session.json
observed: README.md:20-21 claims 'openPage + writeOnPage' spawn study cards (writeOnPage does not exist anywhere in V8 JS or brain.ts; openPage opens browser URLs); README.md:133 claims setup-kursor.cmd writes session.json (seed-local-auth.ps1:83-88 actually writes DPAPI auth.localdev.bin and auth.bin).
expected: README.md should accurately describe drawing primitives (receipt/clipping/paper/sticky) and DPAPI auth files (auth.localdev.bin / auth.bin).

title: C# file count discrepancies in README.md (2,102), AGENTS.md (2,098), and docs/INDEX.md vs ground truth
observed: Actual .cs file counts are reference/decompiled = 2096 (docs claim 2,098 because 6 .csproj files were counted as .cs) and src/desktop = 2097 (docs claim 2,102).
expected: Documentation file counts should match actual .cs file counts (2096 in reference/decompiled, 2097 in src/desktop).

title: 17 broken file:/// source links in docs/06-agents-proactive-and-memory.md
observed: 17 file:/// links in docs/06-agents-proactive-and-memory.md point to non-existent paths (e.g., HeyClicky.Agents.Codex, HeyClicky.Agents.Worker, HeyClicky.Agents.Prompt, HeyClicky.Core.Services/WorkerClient.cs).
expected: All file:/// markdown links in docs/ should resolve to existing files in the repository.

title: Fabricated/stale asset paths and byte sizes in docs/01 and unimplemented items marked COMPLETED in docs/07
observed: docs/01:155-177 places Engine/*.js under BundledResources\ with wrong byte sizes, cites non-existent ClickyBrowserExtensionID.txt, Assets\Clicky\*.png, Assets\Squad\*.png, PlusJakartaSans-*.ttf; docs/07:32,98-132 marks Phases 4-7 COMPLETED including namespace rebranding, kursor:// URI, .kursor file extension, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kursor\ migration.
expected: Architecture inventory (docs/01) and roadmap completion table (docs/07) must reflect actual repository files and implementation state.

title: Backend .env is gitignored and contains no live user API keys
observed: src/backend/.env is covered by .gitignore and all *_KEY= entries are empty.
expected: No developer API keys committed to git history or working tree.

title: Backend test suite counts in docs/INDEX.md (18 + 7 = 25) match test-phase1.ts and test-phase2.ts
observed: test-phase1.ts has 18 testEndpoint calls; test-phase2.ts has 7 testEndpoint calls (total = 25).
expected: 18 tests in test-phase1.ts and 7 tests in test-phase2.ts (25 total).
